context: Naoko teaches a new young server how to take orders at the ramen shop.
purpose: Aunt teaching workplace ropes with warmth and bite.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 注文取るときは、丁寧にな!
lines.en: When you're taking orders, make sure you're polite about it!
lines.style: Brassy, warm authority. Loud opening on the directive, Kansai rhythm underneath. The affectionate firmness of someone training you because she believes you can do it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, sincere earnestness. Quick intake. Respectful but not obsequious. The careful attention of someone who wants to prove she can be trusted.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お客さん、ようけ来るで。
lines.en: A lot of customers come through here.
lines.style: Animated, matter-of-fact. Bright vowels. Not lecturing — sharing the reality of the job like she's giving her a heads-up. Practical warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'll watch myself with every customer.
lines.style: Composed, resolute. Quiet conviction underneath. Not defensive — making a genuine commitment. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: That's it — you're a good one. Go for it!
lines.style: Warm, bright, proud. Loud affection on the encouragement. The energy of someone who loves her and is sending her off to do something that matters to her.
